Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_082638.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_082638.v · Open raw
module origen_082638 (
    input wire USER_CLK,
    input wire [7:0] TX_Data,
    input wire TX_Request,
    output reg FPGA_SERIAL1_TX,
    output reg Busy
);

    reg [9:0] rs232ctr;
    reg rs232clk;
    reg [3:0] rs232state;
    reg [7:0] tx_reg;

    // Clock divider
    always @(posedge USER_CLK) begin
        if (rs232ctr == 10'd867) begin
            rs232ctr <= 10'd0;
            rs232clk <= ~rs232clk;
        end else begin
            rs232ctr <= rs232ctr + 1'b1;
        end
    end

    // State machine and transmission logic
    always @(posedge USER_CLK) begin
        if (TX_Request && !Busy) begin
            rs232state <= 4'b0001;
            tx_reg <= TX_Data;
            Busy <= 1'b1;
        end else if (rs232clk) begin
            case (rs232state)
                4'b0000: begin // Idle state
                    FPGA_SERIAL1_TX <= 1'b1;
                    Busy <= 1'b0;
                end
                4'b0001: begin // Start bit
                    FPGA_SERIAL1_TX <= 1'b0;
                    rs232state <= rs232state + 1'b1;
                end
                4'b0010, 4'b0011, 4'b0100, 4'b0101, 4'b0110, 4'b0111, 4'b1000, 4'b1001: begin // Data bits
                    FPGA_SERIAL1_TX <= tx_reg[0];
                    tx_reg <= {1'b0, tx_reg[7:1]};
                    rs232state <= rs232state + 1'b1;
                end
                4'b1010, 4'b1011: begin // Stop bits
                    FPGA_SERIAL1_TX <= 1'b1;
                    rs232state <= (rs232state == 4'b1011) ? 4'b0000 : rs232state + 1'b1;
                end
                default: rs232state <= 4'b0000;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
